name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 7 – Am 20
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 7a. Recalls that the only way out of the vicious circle of military escalation is through diplomacy; calls, therefore, for the EU to urgently launch an ambitious diplomatic initiative to secure an immediate ceasefire in Ukraine and put an end to the war in Ukraine and the suffering of the Ukrainian people; calls for increased efforts to finally initiate a peace negotiation process which includes all parties;
